title: Assam Passes Land & Revenue Regulation Bill 2026 Creating 5km Heritage Protected Belts
summary: Restricts land transactions within 5 km radius of 250+ year old religious institutions to original inhabitants.

blocks.content: Restricts land transactions within 5 km radius of 250+ year old religious institutions to original inhabitants.

items: Eligibility Criteria: Land sales/purchases within 5-km radius restricted exclusively to SCs, STs, and 'original inhabitants' (75 years documented residence).
Original Inhabitant Definition: Continuous family residence in protected belt for 3 generations as of January 1, 2006 (25 yrs per generation).
